visual_feedback: Correct sideways knee flexion while walking.
Walking hands must sway less; running must have its own visibly distinct animation.
approved_target_design.jump: Flex legs and lower the body for one second before actual takeoff; landing flexes/lowers for one second. Movement, attacks and blocking remain available for both. Any received damage cancels jump preparation; existing jump trajectory/collision remain authoritative after takeoff.
